description_en: Changes the resource group of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-resource-group --db-cluster-id amv-bp1r053byu48p0000 --group-name test --group-type Interactive --min-compute-resource 0ACU --max-compute-resource 48ACU --cluster-size-resource '无' --min-cluster-count 1 --max-cluster-count 1 --cluster-mode '无' --enable-spot true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rules GroupName=user_default QueryTime=180000 TargetGroupName=job --engine-params spark.adb.version_:_3.5 --auto-stop-interval 5m --spec-name Reserved_parameter._Not_applicable. --min-gpu-quantity 1 --max-gpu-quantity 1 --target-resource-group-name Reserved_parameter._Not_applicable. --status starting --ray-config '{"EnableUserEni":true,"AppConfig":{"AppType":"IsaacLab","ImageSelector":{"InferenceEngine":"vLLM","LlmModel":"Deepseek-R1","Image":"lab2.10.0-ray2.43.0"},"AppName":"app01"},"UserDefinedRequirements":"example-string","HeadSpec":"xlarge","HeadDiskCapacity":"100G","Category":"BASIC","HeadSpecType":"CPU","WorkerGroups":[{"GroupName":"test","MinWorkerQuantity":1,"MaxWorkerQuantity":2,"WorkerSpecName":"xlarge","WorkerDiskCapacity":"100G","WorkerSpecType":"GPU","AllocateUnit":"1"}],"HeadAllocateUnit":"1","StorageMounts":[{"MountPath":"/mnt/data01","StorageId":1}]}' --gpu-elastic-plan '{"Enabled":true,"Rules":[{"EndCronExpression":"0_0_3_0_0_0","StartCronExpression":"0_0_2_0_0_0"}]}' --atm-config SelectNodeSpec=8ACU StorageNodeNum=2 StorageNodeDiskType=essd_pl1 InsertNodeSpec=8ACU InsertNodeNum=2 AuthNodeNum=2 StorageNodeSpec=8ACU SelectNodeCacheSize=10 AuthNodeSpec=8ACU SelectNodeNum=1 StorageNodeDiskSize=1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition, Enterprise Edition, or Basic Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the resource group name for a specific cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口查看指定集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:

- **Interactive**

- **Job**

> For more information about resource groups in Data Lakehouse Edition clusters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组类型，取值：
- **Interactive**
- **Job**
> 关于湖仓版资源组的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The minimum amount of reserved computing resources.

- If the resource group type is `Interactive`, the minimum amount of reserved computing resources is 16 ACU.

- If the resource group type is `Job`, the minimum amount of reserved computing resources is 0 ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最小计算预留资源。
- 当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0ACU
parameters.name: min_compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The maximum amount of reserved computing resources. The value cannot exceed the unallocated computing resources of the cluster.

- If the resource group type is `Interactive`, the value is specified in increments of 16 ACU.

- If the resource group type is `Job`, the value is specified in increments of 8 ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最大计算预留资源。
- 当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16ACU。
- 当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8ACU
parameters.name: max_compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the spot instance feature for the resource group. This feature provides resources at a lower unit price, but they can be reclaimed at any time. Only `Job` resource groups support this feature. Valid values:

- **True**: enables the spot instance feature.

- **False**: disables the spot instance feature
parameters.help_zh:
资源组是否开启竞价实例功能。开启竞价实例后资源单价降低，但是有概率被释放。仅Job型资源组可以开启。取值：
- **True**：开启竞价实例功能。
- **False**：关闭竞价实例功能
parameters.name: enable_spot
